ITA-1.9.4.2.11 kharaḥ खरः
Roughness
The quality of a substance which is responsible for roughness.

.9 rasakaḥ/kharparaḥ रसकः/खर्परः
Smithsonite, calamine
Zinc carbonate (ZnCo3). In calcinated form rasaka is used as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral formulations.

.18 khāriḥ खारिः
Measure of weight approximately equal to 196 kg and 608 g
Measure of weight equal to 16384 karsha or 4 droni.
